keyPoints: Do binduon (x1,y1), (x2,y2) ke beech doori = √[(x2-x1)² + (y2-y1)²] — ye Pythagoras prameya se nikalta hai, antar ka varg lo — phir jod kar vargmul.
Mool bindu se (x, y) ki doori = √(x² + y²) — doori sutra me (0,0) rakhne par yehi milta hai.
Vibhajan sutra: (x1,y1)-(x2,y2) ko m:n me baantne wala bindu = ((mx2+nx1)/(m+n), (my2+ny1)/(m+n)) — anupat dhyan se rakho — m:n me m doosre bindu ki taraf hota hai.
Madhy bindu = dono nirdeshankon ka ausat — ((x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2); ye vibhajan ka 1:1 wala khaas roop hai.
Tribhuj ka kshetrafal nirdeshankon se: 1/2 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| — mod lagana mat bhoolo.
Teen bindu sanrekhi (collinear) hain agar unse bana tribhuj ka kshetrafal shunya ho — ek rekha par hone ki jaanch.
Aam galti: vibhajan sutra me m aur n ulta rakhna — m doosre bindu (x2) se judta hai, pehle se nahi.
subject: Maths
title: Doori aur Vibhajan Sutra
